care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

rhs_zh.description: 大型灌木或小乔木，高可达 4 米。 叶片深裂，具 5 至 7 枚裂片。 新叶展开时为绿色，叶缘带乳白色，并晕染粉色；夏季仍能保持乳白色斑锦，至秋季整叶转为橙色或红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其最突出的特征是斑锦叶色，类似 'Kagiri nishiki' 和 'Butterfly'，但春季叶片上的标记为粉橙色而非粉色。 叶片底色为绿色或蓝绿色，边缘具明显白色镶边；白色部分覆有或晕染粉橙色，至夏末转为橙褐色，偶尔整个裂片都会呈橙色。 叶片通常为 5 至 7 裂，大小与形态变化较大；有些裂片细长而整齐，有些则扭曲且宽窄不一。 叶柄较短，呈深红色。 'Beni shichihenge' 生长缓慢，形成直立灌木，高可达约 5 米，冠幅约 2 米。 该品种极具观赏性，常引人注目，尤其在春季更为出色。 其名称意为“红色而多变”。 'Beni shigitatsu sawa' 可视为

products.description_text: Acer palmatum ‘Beni shichihenge' Beni shichihenge Pink Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Beni shichihenge’ is a very beautiful mid-sized Japanese maple that puts on a show of colors. The name ‘Beni shichihenge’ means red and changeful. This Japanese maple tree has a spectacular variegated pink and green leaf that makes it highly sought after. In the early spring, ‘Beni shichihenge’ comes out with a light green inner leaf surrounded by magnificent pink margins. The beautiful display of color is maintained deep into the summer months. During this time, the pink border on this Japanese maple transforms into a nice cream color adding another beautiful color pattern. In the autumn months, ‘Beni shichihenge’ replaces the cream with tones of orange and red. For the best color performance, we recommend filtered afternoon light. The growth habit is upright and this Japanese maple tree can reach 10-12 ft over time. ‘Beni shichihenge’ adds an amazing splash of color and will truly become one of your favorite trees. These 7 & 10 gallon trees are for local pickup only, we cannot ship them because they are too big. The MrMaple Nursery is located in East Flat Rock, NC. Please contact us to arrange a pickup time.
